package lib

type Buffer struct {
	chunks []string
}

func NewBuffer() *Buffer {
	return &Buffer{}
}

func (b *Buffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	b.chunks = append(b.chunks, string(p))
	return len(p), nil
}

func (b *Buffer) String() string {
	out := ""
	for _, c := range b.chunks {
		out += c
	}
	return out
}
